content.text:
## 1) Stripe / GROK env var **names** (no values)

**Present in `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\.env`:**
- `STRIPE_PRICING_TABLE_ID`
- `STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`
- `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`
- `STRIPE_ROOTMC_PRODUCT_ID`
- `STRIPE_ROOTMC_PAYMENT_LINK`
- `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (RootRecord; RootMC deploy does **not** use this)
- `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_ROOTMC` → uploaded as Worker `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`
- `STRIPE_ROOTMC_PRICE_MONTHLY` / `_ONE_MONTH` / `_LIFETIME`
- `STRIPE_ROOTMC_PAYMENT_LINK_MONTHLY` / `_ONE_MONTH` / `_LIFETIME`
- GROK (unrelated to Stripe): `GROK_API_BEARER_TOKEN`, `GROK_ROOT_ASK_BEARER_TOKEN`, `GROK_X_BEARER_TOKEN`, `GROK_X_V1_CONSUMER_KEY`, `GROK_X_V1_CONSUMER_KEY_SECRET`, `GROK_X_V2_CLIENT_ID`, `GROK_X_V2_CLIENT_SECRET`

**Also referenced in code/docs (not all in RootMC `.env`):**
- `STRIPE_PRICE_ID` — web Checkout Session (`billing-stripe.ts`)
- `STRIPE_MEMBERSHIP_PRODUCT_ID` — fallback product filter in `stripe-webhook.ts`
- Ava Grok model keys: `AVA_GROK_API_KEY`, `AVA_GROK_MODEL` / `SEXI_GROK_MODEL`

**Docs / config paths:**  
`Web Files\rootmc-api\STRIPE-WEBHOOK.md`, `wrangler.toml`, `deploy.ps1`, `rootmc-realm-api\src\primary-auth.ts`

**Ava Ivy:** no Stripe secret names in notes; only “never dump Stripe / never paste `buy.stripe.com`”.

---

## 2) Finance notes (summaries)

| File | Says |
|------|------|
| `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\AVA-FINANCE-ROUTING-v1.md` | Active allocation ranges (ops 35–45%, Ava slice **10–15%**, etc.). Named Ava goals (990 PRO, RTX laptop, OptiPlex). Weekly Telegram brief to Alex; no secrets in Discord; ~$100 site spend PROP-gated. |
| `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\AVA-INCOME-BACKLOG-v1.md` | Chase order: Telegram surface → Solana audit → Pro funnel. Hard gates: no treasury mint for wishlist; secrets in `.env` only. |
| `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\AVA-GOALS.md` | Financial-advisor lane Active; pie slice; Telegram bot live (`AVA_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`); Membership $→Vote Shards **Proposed**; hardware wishlist; points at routing + income backlog. |
| `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\TELEGRAM-INCOME-UX-2026-08-02.md` | When Alex asks income/Pro on Telegram: one-line vibe + masked `https://rootmc.net/pro/` + Discord `#proposals` for Gold spends — **never dump Stripe**. Operator-first. |

---

## 3) Ava player profile storage

**Root:** `AVA_HANDOFF` → `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\` (`config.mjs` → `store.mjs`)

| Store | Key | Path | Functions |
|-------|-----|------|-----------|
| Discord / Slack living profiles | **Discord id** (also Slack ids like `U0BL…` as filename) | `…\data\players\<id>.json` | `loadPlayerProfile`, `savePlayerProfileMut`, `observePlayerLine`, `gatherAskerProfile`, `recordCursorUsage` |
| In-game personality samples | **Minecraft name** (lowercased, alnum/`_`, max 16) — **not UUID** | `…\data\players\mc\<name>.json` | `observeMinecraftLine` |
| Hard-coded people | discord / minecraft / telegram / slack ids | in-code `KNOWN_PEOPLE` | `personByDiscordId`, `personByTelegramId`, `personByAuthorId`, `personByName`, `gatherPeopleContext` |

**Files:**  
`Web Files\rootmc-ava\src\playerProfiles.mjs`, `people.mjs`, `store.mjs`  
No UUID primary key on Ava local profiles; MC side is name-keyed. Membership flag is `profile.member` + Discord role (`membership.mjs`).

---

## 4) Stripe API usage in Web Files

**Ava (`rootmc-ava`):** **none** — masked Pro links only (`membershipPro.mjs`).

**Worker / shared (live):**
| Path | Key exports / role |
|------|-------------------|
| `Web Files\shared\stripe-webhook.ts` | `handleStripeWebhook`; `stripeGet` → `/subscriptions`, `/customers`, checkout sessions; events: checkout completed, sub update/delete, invoice paid/failed, disputes, refunds |
| `Web Files\shared\apply-stripe-billing.ts` | `applyStripeBillingPatch`, `applyStripeBillingRevoke` → D1 `user_accounts` |
| `Web Files\shared\rootmc-pro-billing.ts` | `parseRootMcStripePrices`, `classifyRootMcPriceId`, `queueProVoucherToVault`, `resolveBeneficiaryByMinecraftUsername`, … |
| `Web Files\shared\stripe-reconcile.ts` | `reconcileStaleStripeSubscriptions` |
| `Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\billing-stripe.ts` | `billingCheckoutAvailable`, `createStripeSubscriptionCheckout` → `POST /v1/checkout/sessions` |
| `Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\realm-router.ts` | routes `POST /v1/stripe/webhook` |
| `Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\rootmc-pro-vouchers.ts` | `redeemProVoucher` (+ re-exports vault queue) |

No Stripe **Balance** / payouts / BalanceTransaction reader exists today (`ensureRootsBalance` is in-app Roots currency, not Stripe).

---

## 5) Membership / Pro payment flow today

1. Player → masked site: `rootmc.net/pro/` → `/monthly|one-month|lifetime/`  
2. Those pages **meta-refresh to Payment Links** (`buy.stripe.com/…` from wrangler vars)  
3. Stripe webhook → `api.rootmc.net/v1/stripe/webhook` → `handleStripeWebhook`  
4. Classifies RootMC prices → billing patch and/or **Pro vouchers** (`queueProVoucherToVault`)  
5. In-game/app redeem via `redeemProVoucher` / vault  
6. Ava never calls Stripe; she sells via `gatherProMembershipBrief` + `PRO_LINKS` only  

Also: Discord role / `profile.member` for Cursor soft-gate (`membership.mjs`); Vote Shard ×2 is governance/Pro entitlement on API side.

---

## 6) Poller hooks pattern (periodic jobs)

**File:** `Web Files\rootmc-ava\src\poller.mjs`

Pattern (same as `ingameChatAssist`):
- Module exports `*IntervalMs()` / `*BootDelayMs()` + `run*({ env, force })`
- Module keeps state under `storePaths().dir` (e.g. `ingame-chat-assist.json`)
- Poller tick: boot delay once, then interval; guards `live && !isHushed() && !isAsleep()`
- Optional one-shot `setTimeout` at boot

**`ingameChatAssist.mjs` keys:** `ingameChatAssistIntervalMs`, `ingameChatAssistBootDelayMs`, `runIngameChatAssist`  
Env: `AVA_INGAME_CHAT_MS`, `AVA_INGAME_CHAT_BOOT_MS`

Sibling hooks in same poller: pending tasks, follow-up scan, channel dump, urgent Telegram, commitment chase, RSS, host metrics, EcoFlow.

---

## 7) Telegram income UX

Present: `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\TELEGRAM-INCOME-UX-2026-08-02.md` (summarized in §2). Bot token name: `AVA_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` (per AVA-GOALS).

---

## Recommended integration points

### Ava reading Stripe balances / income
- **New module** under `Web Files\rootmc-ava\src\` (e.g. `stripeIncome.mjs`) using `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` from `loadEnv()` — read-only `GET /v1/balance` + BalanceTransactions / charges filtered by RootMC price/product ids already in env.
- **Do not** hang this on the Worker webhook path; keep ops read in Ava Node like EcoFlow/host metrics.
- Surface: Telegram operator digests (`urgentTelegram.mjs` / weekly brief called out in finance routing) — never Discord public.

### Ops expenses ledger
- New store under `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\data\` (e.g. `finance\ops-ledger.jsonl`) + note sibling to `AVA-FINANCE-ROUTING-v1.md`.
- Manual / Ava-logged entries (hosting, domains, CF); compare against Stripe income in weekly Telegram brief.
- Allocation math can live next to routing ranges already documented.

### Per-player isolated finance (opt-in)
- Extend Discord profiles via `savePlayerProfileMut` with explicit opt-in flag (mirror `dream-dm-opt-in` style notes).
- Keep **isolated** from MC Gold / treasury; never mint Gold from this.
- Link Discord ↔ Minecraft via `KNOWN_PEOPLE` / verify API — do not key finance on MC name alone (collision risk); prefer Discord id + linked UUID from `api.rootmc.net` when available.
- MC-only samples stay in `players/mc/` without money fields unless linked + opted in.

### Periodic review → suggested updates
- Clone **ingameChatAssist poller hook**: `financeReviewIntervalMs` + `runFinanceReview` in `poller.mjs`.
- Weekly: pull Stripe income snapshot → compare to routing ranges / backlog / goals → Telegram to Alex with suggested routing or backlog bumps (PROP-gated spends).
- Persona absorb: finance advisor line in `persona.mjs` + `TELEGRAM-INCOME-UX` reply shape already drafted.

**Hard constraints already in repo:** Gold ≠ dollars; no Ava Stripe dumps in public; masked Pro links only; Ava has no Stripe client yet — all payment truth is Worker webhook + D1 entitlements.
